name: lux
description: LUX Premium Mobility — Firebase monorepo (Customer, Driver, Admin)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lux/contracts && npm run build -w @lux/functions && npm run build -w @lux/admin-web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lux/contracts && npm run lint -w @lux/functions && npm run lint -w @lux/admin-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lux/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @lux/functions && npm run typecheck -w @lux/admin-web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lux/contracts && npm run test -w @lux/functions
